classification: rejected - fails leave-one-company-out, neighborhood, and bootstrap falsification
predecessor: sec_form4_insider_cluster_v1 (rejected as a static blend; this experiment tests the same signal as a causal conditional overlay instead)

structure.gate: shifted rolling trend comparison, lookback in {8, 13, 26} weeks, allocation in {10%, 20%, 30%} only when the sleeve's trend exceeds both zero and the leader's trend

rejection_reason: The screened candidate passes surface promotion gates (higher trailing-1y and full CAGR, similar Sharpe and drawdown, still ahead of control at 200 bps) but fails the falsification gauntlet: excluding ProFrac Holding Corp. drops trailing-1y CAGR from 108.43% to 99.27%, below the unchanged control's 105.10%; only 33.3% of the same family's neighboring combinations jointly improve recent and full CAGR versus the required 50%; and 4-week/13-week block-bootstrap probabilities of positive excess return are 69.52%/86.14%, both below the required 95%. The corrected completed-window calculation does pass at 56.44% across 163 rolling 26-week windows, but that does not offset the other failures.
diagnostic_notes: The selected candidate's trailing-one-year maximum drawdown (-10.08%) matches the control to numerical precision, meaning it was inactive during the leader's worst week in that window; this does not establish protection during genuine portfolio stress.

The selected candidate's year-to-date 2026 CAGR is identical to the control to numerical precision because its gate has not activated in calendar-year 2026; its trailing-one-year improvement is concentrated in a minority of weeks in 2025.
1- and 2-week signal delays still beat the control (106.76% and 106.61%), so the timing/lag dimension is not the failure mode; the failure is concentration and low-frequency robustness.
